turns.text: Hey there, how have things been?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ah, it's been a long day.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My bike's back tire has gone flat again.

turns.speaker: moshi

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One second, someone's calling me. Don't talk until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm calling back about the apartment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Could I see it this weekend?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I hung up. I'm all yours.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Welcome back. Still deciding between patching the tube and visiting the bike shop?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Shop, I think. If it keeps happening I want a better tire.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That makes sense. Ask them about a puncture resistant tire.
